tasks.design: Configure native funder headings in {DOCS} and budget formulas in {SPREADSHEET}, using actual rates from {ERP}. Bound grant drafting to actual research decisions; the biologist retains scientific planning and complete final proposal checks before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proposal writing can repeat requirement navigation, budget entry and narrative production.
tasks.enabler_now: Native proposal fields, budget formulas and bounded drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: A feasible research case and justified funding need require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises an attractive promise that the research cannot support.
tasks.altitude: Less proposal production; scientific aims remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native proposal templates, budget formulas and bounded drafting can support grant writing; they do not establish scientific merit, eligibility or funding success.

assumptions: Actual funder supplies call/version; institution/finance supplies actual rates/rules. Biologist verifies sources in s1, chooses actual aims/quantities in s2 and checks rates/exceptions within retained s3. Missing values remain manual.

S3 reduces repeated budget transfer/formula setup, not resource decisions or existing calculation runtime. Retained s4 captures/corrects actual research meaning; full final proposal review stays in s5.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native templates/formulas first; existing automation earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing final check.

Task writes proposals; actual institutional authorisation and funder submission require separate exact-final-version approvals and gated send if included. No submission, funding outcome or avoided institutional approval labour is assumed.
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce proposal production after complete scientific/budget review?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct actual grant meaning within s4.

incremental.description: Maintain actual funder fields, rate mappings and grant drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final actual grant proposal and exact internal project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 requirement navigation + 15*0.40 budget setup + 20*0.40 prose = 20; minus 1.5 upkeep = 18.5. Half eligible gives 10 minus 1.5 = 8.5. Research choices, full review and save retained.

tasks.design: Configure native course/student/source links in {LMS}, {DOCS} and laboratory research software {OTHER}. The biologist retains teaching, supervision, research and actual record capture/check; each actual record is saved separately in its destination system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Academic work preparation can repeat source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked sources can reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Student learning and biological research need actual interaction and investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises misunderstanding and uncertain evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less academic lookup; teaching and research remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course/research-source links can support academic preparation; they do not teach, supervise or conduct research.

assumptions: Actual course/study owners and students supply source materials/work; biologist checks relevance in s1. Actual instruction, observation, research design/execution, interpretation and record capture stay retained.

Teaching, supervision and research are alternative academic duties in a provisional task mix, not a mandatory sequence per session. S4/s5 instantiate only the actual required record in that branch; each separate system write is its own instance, not one cross-system commit.

Shares are not measured baselines. Native links first; existing access and computational runtime earn zero saving. Preparation counted once per actual revision/session; shared research capture counted once across research outputs.
Routine save retains one percent using existing final check. Any actual feedback/report delivery must be its own exact-final-version gated send; no invented send or avoided delivery labour here.
research_questions: Can native links shorten preparation while retaining instruction and research?

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual branch-specific record and exact student/course or experiment destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 source navigation = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Teaching, supervision, research and actual records retained.

tasks.previous_blocker: Scope preparation can repeat template navigation and scientific prose after decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native template fields and bounded drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Clear deliverables and testable acceptance criteria require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises a plausible scope that would not deliver usable research outputs.
tasks.altitude: Less scope prose; scientific requirements stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native procurement templates and bounded scope drafting can support request/statement preparation; they do not confer procurement or contracting authority.

assumptions: Actual project/procurement owners supply constraints and current templates; biologist captures actual scope/acceptance decisions in s1 and checks sources in s2. No free structured scope.
Retained s3 includes capture/correction of actual scope meaning; complete final scope review remains in s4. Native headings/clauses first; existing template assembly earns zero saving.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Request and statement are alternative documents. Save retains one percent using existing final check. Task prepares documents; actual procurement approval, supplier issue or contractual commitment must each be separate exact-final-version gated actions if actual duty, with no avoided labour claimed.

tasks.previous_blocker: Result communication can repeat prose after interpretation and audience choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can express supplied results and uncertainty in audience-appropriate language.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate public meaning and disclosure decisions require expert judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises a technically accurate phrase that would mislead the audience.
tasks.altitude: Less explanation drafting; responsible communication stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded source-linked drafting can support test-result explanations; it does not establish valid interpretation or permission to disclose results.

assumptions: Actual testing owner supplies checked results/version and limitations; biologist verifies these and actual audience/disclosure scope in s1. Actual chosen interpretation is captured/corrected within retained s2, not inferred from raw results.
All substantive final checking and actual discussion remain retained. Preparation is counted once per actual communication version, not per recipient/question.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Oral discussion and written delivery are actual alternative channels; remove unused branches and reweight rather than mandating a written report. Native result fields first; existing templated prose earns zero saving.

Save/send each retain one percent using existing final check after complete communication exists. Any actual organisational disclosure approval must cover exact final version before release; no new authority or avoided approval labour assumed. Results are communicated only after actual testing.
